en.t: The Great Fire of Rome causes widespread devastation and rages on for six days, destroying half of the city
en.s: The Great Fire of Rome (Latin: incendium magnum Romae) began on the evening of 18–19 July 64 AD. The fire started in the merchant shops around Rome's chariot stadium, Circus Maximus. After six days, the fire was brought under control, but before the damage could be assessed, the fire reignited and burned for another three days.

zh.t: 罗马大火造成广泛破坏，持续六天并烧毁半座城市
zh.s: 公元64年7月18日至19日夜间，罗马大火开始于马克西穆斯竞技场周围的商铺。六天后，火势一度得到控制；但损失尚未评估完毕，火灾又复燃并持续了三天。

en.t: Leontius, Roman usurper, is crowned Eastern emperor at Tarsus (modern Turkey). He is recognized in Antioch and makes it his capital
en.s: Leontius (Greek: Λεόντιος, romanized: Leóntios; died 488) was a general of the Eastern Roman Empire and claimant to the throne who led a rebellion against Emperor Zeno in 484–488.

zh.t: 罗马篡位者莱昂提乌斯在塔尔苏斯（今土耳其）加冕为东罗马皇帝，并获安条克承认，将其定为首都
zh.s: 莱昂提乌斯（希腊语：Λεόντιος；转写：Leóntios；卒于488年）是东罗马帝国将领和皇位觊觎者，曾于484年至488年发动叛乱，反抗皇帝芝诺。

en.s: The Battle of Guadalete was the first major battle of the Muslim conquest of the Iberian Peninsula, fought in July 711 at an unidentified location in what is now southern Spain between the Visigoths under their king, Roderic, and the invading forces of the Umayyad Caliphate, composed of mainly Berbers and some Arabs under the commander Tariq ibn Ziyad.
en.n: Umayyad conquest of Hispania: Battle of Guadalete: Umayyad forces under Tariq ibn Ziyad defeat the Visigoths led by King Roderic.

zh.s: 瓜达莱特战役是穆斯林征服伊比利亚半岛期间的首场大规模战役，于711年7月在今西班牙南部某处爆发，具体地点不详。交战双方是西哥特军队和入侵的倭马亚哈里发军队：西哥特军由国王罗德里克率领，倭马亚军主要由柏柏尔人组成，也有一些阿拉伯人，由塔里克·伊本·齐亚德指挥。
zh.n: 倭马亚征服西班牙：瓜达莱特战役：塔里克·伊本·齐亚德率领的倭马亚军击败罗德里克国王领导的西哥特人。

en.s: The Battle of Simancas (also called Alhandega or al-Khandaq) was a military battle that started on July 19, 939, in the Iberian Peninsula between the troops of the king of León Ramiro II and Cordovan caliph Abd al-Rahman III near the walls of the city of Simancas. The battle decided the control of the lands of the Duero. The battle unfolded after the army of Abd al-Rahman III launched toward the northern Christian territories in 934. Abd al-Rahman III had gathered a large army of caliphal fighters, with the help of the Andalusian governor of Zaragoza, Abu Yahya.

zh.s: 西曼卡斯战役又称阿尔汉德加战役或“战壕”战役，于939年7月19日在伊比利亚半岛爆发。交战双方是莱昂国王拉米罗二世的军队和科尔多瓦哈里发阿卜杜勒·拉赫曼三世的军队，战场靠近西曼卡斯城墙。战役决定了杜罗河地区的控制权。934年，阿卜杜勒·拉赫曼三世的军队向北方基督教领地进军，此后战事逐渐展开。他集结了一支庞大的哈里发军队，并得到萨拉戈萨安达卢斯总督阿布·叶海亚的协助。

en.s: The Battle of Apamea was fought on 19 July 998 between the forces of the Byzantine Empire and the Fatimid Caliphate. The battle was part of a series of military confrontations between the two powers over control of northern Syria and the Hamdanid emirate of Aleppo, which in turn were part of the larger series of regional conflicts known as the Arab–Byzantine wars.

zh.s: 阿帕米亚战役于998年7月19日爆发，交战双方是拜占庭帝国和法蒂玛王朝。战役属于两大势力为争夺叙利亚北部和阿勒颇哈姆丹王朝埃米尔国控制权而发生的一系列军事冲突之一；这些冲突又是阿拉伯—拜占庭战争这一地区性长期冲突的一部分。

en.s: The Battle of Llantada or Llantadilla was a border skirmish fought on 19 July 1068 on the banks of the Pisuerga near the frontier between León and Castile. There Sancho II of Castile defeated his brother Alfonso VI of León. Though Rodrigo Díaz de Vivar is usually associated with this battle, the evidence of his presence there is rather late and his influence in Castile at that early stage of his career too slight to make plausible the tradition that he was Sancho's alférez.

zh.s: 良塔达战役又称良塔迪利亚战役，是1068年7月19日在比斯埃尔加河岸边、莱昂与卡斯蒂利亚边界附近发生的一场边境冲突。卡斯蒂利亚的桑乔二世在战斗中击败了他的兄弟、莱昂国王阿方索六世。人们通常将罗德里戈·迪亚斯·德·比瓦尔与这场战役联系起来，但证明他在场的证据出现得较晚；他在职业生涯早期对卡斯蒂利亚的影响也很有限，因此，他曾任桑乔旗手的说法不太可信。

en.s: The Battle of Halidon Hill took place on 19 July 1333 when a Scottish army under Sir Archibald Douglas attacked an English army commanded by King Edward III of England (r. 1327–1377) and was heavily defeated. The year before, Edward Balliol had seized the Scottish Crown from five-year-old David II (r. 1329–1371), surreptitiously supported by Edward III. This marked the start of the Second War of Scottish Independence.

zh.s: 1333年7月19日，阿奇博尔德·道格拉斯爵士率领苏格兰军队进攻英格兰军队，遭到惨败。英军由英格兰国王爱德华三世（在位1327—1377年）指挥。前一年，爱德华·巴里奥尔夺取了年仅5岁的苏格兰国王大卫二世（在位1329—1371年）的王位，爱德华三世暗中支持了这次行动。此事标志着第二次苏格兰独立战争开始。

en.t: Siege of the Tower of London (1460)
en.s: The siege of the Tower of London was an episode of the Wars of the Roses, in which adherents of the rival Plantagenet houses of Lancaster and York were pitted against each other. In June 1460, several Yorkist nobles, who had unsuccessfully rebelled against King Henry VI the year before and had fled to Calais, invaded the south east of England at Sandwich.

zh.s: 伦敦塔围城战是玫瑰战争中的一段插曲，金雀花王朝的兰开斯特家族和约克家族支持者彼此交战。1460年6月，数名约克派贵族曾在前一年反抗亨利六世国王失败，随后逃往加来；他们从桑威奇入侵英格兰东南部。

en.s: The naval Battle of the Solent took place on 18 and 19 July 1545 during the Italian Wars, between the fleets of Francis I of France and Henry VIII of England, in the Solent, between Hampshire and the Isle of Wight. This was one of only two full-fledged naval battles fought by King Henry VIII's Tudor navy, along with the earlier Battle of Saint-Mathieu.

zh.s: 索伦特海战于1545年7月18日至19日在意大利战争期间爆发，交战双方是法国国王弗朗索瓦一世和英格兰国王亨利八世的舰队，战场位于汉普郡与怀特岛之间的索伦特海峡。这是亨利八世的都铎海军仅有的两场全面海战之一，另一场是此前发生的圣马蒂厄海战。

en.t: The Tudor warship Mary Rose sinks off Portsmouth; in 1982 the wreck is salvaged in one of the most complex and expensive projects in the history of maritime archaeology
en.s: The Mary Rose was a carrack in the English Tudor navy of King Henry VIII. She was launched in 1511 and served for 34 years in several wars against France, Scotland, and Brittany. After being substantially rebuilt in 1536, she saw her last action on 19 July 1545. She led the attack on the galleys of a French invasion fleet, but sank off Spithead in the Solent, the strait north of the Isle of Wight.

zh.t: 都铎王朝战舰玛丽·罗斯号在朴茨茅斯附近沉没；1982年，打捞残骸的工程成为海洋考古史上最复杂、最昂贵的项目之一
zh.s: 玛丽·罗斯号是英格兰都铎王朝海军的一艘卡拉克帆船，隶属亨利八世。它于1511年下水，在对法兰西、苏格兰和布列塔尼的数场战争中服役34年。该船于1536年大幅改造，最后一次参战是在1545年7月19日。它率先攻击法国入侵舰队的桨帆船，随后在索伦特海峡的斯皮特黑德附近沉没；索伦特海峡位于怀特岛以北。

en.s: The Battle of Brest (Croatian: Bitka kod Bresta) was fought on 19 July 1592 between the Ottoman forces of Hasan Pasha Predojević, Beglerbeg of Bosnia, and the Germanic and Croatian forces led by Thomas Erdődy, Ban of Croatia. The battle was a part of the Croatian–Ottoman wars and Ottoman–Habsburg wars between the Ottoman Empire and the Habsburg Monarchy. The Ottoman forces were about 7,000-8,000 men, and Erdödy's army consisted of 1,600 infantry and 400 cavalry from Styria, 500 men arrived under Erdödy's command, and an unknown number (several hundred) of peasants from Croatia. In total, the forces gathered at Erdödy's camp were about 3,000 men.

zh.s: 布雷斯特战役（克罗地亚语：Bitka kod Bresta）于1592年7月19日爆发，交战双方是波斯尼亚贝伊勒贝伊哈桑·帕夏·普雷多耶维奇率领的奥斯曼军队，以及由克罗地亚总督托马斯·埃尔德迪率领的德意志和克罗地亚军队。战役属于克罗地亚—奥斯曼战争和奥斯曼—哈布斯堡战争的一部分。奥斯曼军队约有7,000至8,000人。埃尔德迪的军队包括施蒂里亚派来的1,600名步兵和400名骑兵、由埃尔德迪带来的500人，以及人数不详（数百人）的克罗地亚农民，总计约3,000人集结在埃尔德迪的营地。

en.s: The siege of Pyongyang was part of the Japanese invasions of Korea. Konishi Yukinaga, a Japanese daimyō, captured Pyongyang and garrisoned his force there in the winter of 1592.

en.s: The Battle of Dalnaspidal occurred on 19 July 1654 during the Wars of the Three Kingdoms. It was one of the last engagements in the war bringing an end to the Royalist rising of 1653 to 1654.

zh.s: 达尔纳斯皮达尔战役于1654年7月19日在三国之战期间爆发。这是战争结束前的最后几场交战之一，也终结了1653年至1654年的保王党起义。

en.s: The Fourth Battle of the Dardanelles in the Fifth Ottoman-Venetian War took place between 17 and 19 July 1657 outside the mouth of the Dardanelles Strait. The Ottomans succeeded in breaking the Venetian blockade over the Strait. Venice's navy had been positioned at the south of the narrows during the engagement. A strong northerly wind had given the Turkish a favorable position.

zh.s: 第五次奥斯曼—威尼斯战争中的第四次达达尼尔海峡战役于1657年7月17日至19日在达达尼尔海峡入口外海爆发。奥斯曼方面成功打破威尼斯对海峡的封锁。战斗期间，威尼斯舰队部署在海峡狭窄段以南；强劲的北风使奥斯曼舰队占据有利位置。

en.s: This page is partially a translation of the French version The Siege of Léva (Slovak: Levice) was fought on July 19, 1664 as part of the Austro-Turkish War (1663-1664), between a Habsburg army led by Jean-Louis Raduit de Souches and an Ottoman army under the command of Ali Pasha. The battle took place near Léva in present-day Slovakia and was a Habsburg victory.

zh.s: 莱瓦（斯洛伐克语：Levice）围城战于1664年7月19日爆发，是1663—1664年奥土战争的一部分。交战双方是让-路易·拉迪伊·德·苏什率领的哈布斯堡军队和阿里帕夏指挥的奥斯曼军队。战斗发生在今斯洛伐克莱瓦附近，以哈布斯堡军队获胜告终。

en.s: Deed from the Five Nations to the King, of their Beaver Hunting Ground, more commonly known as the Nanfan Treaty, was an agreement made between representatives of the Haudenosaunee Confederacy with John Nanfan, the acting colonial governor of New York, on behalf of The Crown. The treaty was conducted in Albany, New York, on July 19, 1701, and amended by both parties on September 14, 1726.

zh.s: 南凡条约又称《五族将其海狸狩猎地转交国王的契约》，是豪德诺索尼联盟代表与纽约殖民地代理总督约翰·南凡代表英国王室达成的一项协议。条约于1701年7月19日在纽约州奥尔巴尼签订，双方又于1726年9月14日对其作出修订。

en.s: The Crossing of the Düna (also known as Battle of Daugava or Battle of Spilves) took place during the Great Northern War on July 19, 1701 near the city of Riga, present-day Latvia. The Swedish king Charles XII was in hot pursuit of king Augustus II the Strong of the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth and Saxony. The crossing was easily made, and the coalition troops were quickly broken and retreated.
en.n: The Crossing of the Düna (also known as Battle of Daugava or Battle of Spilves) took place during the Great Northern War on 19 July 1701 near the city of Riga, present-day Latvia.

zh.s: 杜纳河渡河战又称道加瓦河战役或斯皮尔韦战役，于1701年7月19日在大北方战争期间、今拉脱维亚首都里加附近发生。瑞典国王卡尔十二世紧追波兰—立陶宛联邦和萨克森统治者、强者奥古斯特二世。瑞典军队顺利渡河，联军很快被击溃并撤退。
zh.n: 杜纳河渡河战又称道加瓦河战役或斯皮尔韦战役，于1701年7月19日在大北方战争期间、今拉脱维亚首都里加附近发生。

en.s: The Battle of Kliszów (Klissow) (Klezow) took place on July 8 (Julian calendar) / July 9 (Swedish calendar) / July 19, 1702 (Gregorian calendar) near Kliszów, Poland-Lithuania, during the Great Northern War. The numerically superior Polish-Saxon army of August II the Strong, operating from an advantageous defensive position, was defeated by a Swedish army half its size under the command of King Charles XII.

zh.s: 克利绍夫战役又称克利索夫战役或克莱佐夫战役，于1702年7月19日（公历；儒略历7月8日、瑞典历7月9日）在波兰—立陶宛境内的克利绍夫附近爆发，是大北方战争的一部分。奥古斯特二世统率的波兰—萨克森联军虽人数占优且占据有利防守位置，仍被规模只有其一半的瑞典军队击败。瑞典军由国王卡尔十二世指挥。

en.s: The Battle of Systerbäck took place on July 19, 1703 near the Sestra River during the Great Northern War. The Swedish army under the command of Abraham Cronhjort had to pull back to escape encirclement of the much larger Russian force under Boris Sheremetev. The two sides estimated their losses to 390 Swedish dead and wounded and 150 Russians dead and wounded.

zh.s: 西斯特尔巴克战役于1703年7月19日在大北方战争期间、谢斯特拉河附近爆发。亚伯拉罕·克龙希尔特指挥的瑞典军队不得不撤退，以免被鲍里斯·谢列梅捷夫率领的规模大得多的俄军包围。双方估计损失分别为：瑞典军390人死伤，俄军150人死伤。

en.s: The Battle of Matapan, also known as the Battle of Cape Matapan, was a naval battle in the Laconian Gulf, an arm of the Mediterranean Sea, fought between the Kingdom of Portugal and the Ottoman Empire on 19 July 1717, off Cape Matapan in southern Greece. It was part of the Seventh Ottoman-Venetian War of 1714 – 1718.

zh.s: 马塔潘战役又称马塔潘角海战，是1717年7月19日在希腊南部马塔潘角附近拉科尼亚湾爆发的一场海战，交战双方为葡萄牙王国和奥斯曼帝国。战役属于1714年至1718年的第七次奥斯曼—威尼斯战争。

en.s: The Battle of Samarra was the key engagement between the two great generals Nader Shah and Topal Osman Pasha, which led to the siege of Baghdad being lifted, keeping Ottoman Iraq under Istanbul's control. The armed contest between the two colossi was very hard fought, with a total of roughly 50,000 men becoming casualties by the end of the fighting that left the Persians decimated and the Ottoman victors badly shaken.

zh.s: 萨迈拉战役是纳迪尔·沙阿与托帕尔·奥斯曼帕夏两位名将之间的关键交战，战后巴格达之围解除，奥斯曼帝国得以继续控制奥斯曼伊拉克。双方激烈交战，战斗结束时约有50,000人伤亡。波斯军队损失惨重，获胜的奥斯曼军队也受到重创。

en.s: The Battle of Assietta was a significant engagement of the War of the Austrian Succession and pitted a numerically superior French force of 25,000–40,000 men under the command of Louis Fouquet, Chevalier de Belle-Isle against a Sardinian army of 7,000–15,000 men led by Giovanni di Bricherasio. The French were soundly defeated and their commander, Belle-Isle, killed during the course of the battle.

zh.s: 阿西耶塔战役是奥地利王位继承战争中的一场重要战斗。路易·福凯·德·贝尔岛骑士率领2.5万至4万名法军，对阵乔瓦尼·迪·布里凯拉西奥率领的7,000至15,000名撒丁军。法军遭到惨败，贝尔岛在战斗中阵亡。

en.s: In the Second Battle of Lutterberg (19 July 1762), the Franco-Saxon contingent under General the Comte de Lusace were defeated by Prince Ferdinand.

zh.s: 1762年7月19日，卢萨斯伯爵率领的法萨联军在吕特贝格第二次战役中被费迪南亲王击败。

en.s: The Battle of Katwa (1763) occurred between the Nawab of Bengal, Mir Qasim and the British East India Company in 1763. Dissatisfied with Nawab Mir Qasim's administration, the English deposed him in favor of his father-in-law Mir Jafar and officially declared war against Mir Qasim on July 7, 1763. The English command was given to Major Thomas Adams, who led a small force, variously estimated as between 3,000 and 5,000 men, of whom, approximately 1,000 were European.

zh.s: 1763年，孟加拉纳瓦卜米尔·卡西姆与英国东印度公司在卡特瓦交战。英国人不满米尔·卡西姆的统治，扶植其岳父米尔·贾法尔取代他，并于7月7日正式向米尔·卡西姆宣战。英国军队由托马斯·亚当斯少校指挥，兵力约3000至5000人，其中约1000名欧洲人。

en.s: The naval Battle of (the) Kerch Strait (also known as Battle of Yenikale, by the old Turkish name of the strait near Kerch) took place on 19 July 1790 near Kerch, Crimea, was a victory for Imperial Russia over the Ottoman Empire during the Russo-Turkish War, 1787-1792.

zh.s: 刻赤海峡海战又称叶尼卡莱海战，旧时土耳其语以叶尼卡莱称呼刻赤附近的海峡。海战于1790年7月19日在克里米亚刻赤附近爆发，是1787—1792年俄土战争期间俄罗斯帝国战胜奥斯曼帝国的一场海战。

en.s: The Battle of Bailén was fought in 1808 between the Spanish Army's Army of Andalusia, under General Francisco Javier Castaños and the French Imperial Army's 2nd Gironde Observational Corps under Divisional-General Pierre Dupont de l'Étang. The first open-field defeat of a Napoleonic army, the battle's heaviest fighting took place near Bailén (sometimes anglicized as Baylen), a village by the Guadalquivir river in the Jaén province of southern Spain.

zh.s: 1808年，西班牙安达卢西亚军团在弗朗西斯科·哈维尔·卡斯塔尼奥斯将军指挥下，与法国帝国军队第二吉伦特观察军团交战，法军由皮埃尔·杜邦·德·莱唐少将指挥。拜伦战役是拿破仑军队首次在野战中战败，最激烈的战斗发生在西班牙南部哈恩省瓜达尔基维尔河畔的拜伦村附近（英文有时拼作Baylen）。

en.s: The First Battle of Sacket's Harbor (also spelled as Sackett's) was fought on July 19, 1812, between the United States and the British Empire; it was the first engagement of the war between these forces. It resulted in American forces repelling the attack on the village and its important shipbuilding yard, where 12 warships were built for this war.

zh.s: 萨克茨港第一次战役又拼作萨克茨港，于1812年7月19日在美国与大英帝国之间爆发，是双方在1812年战争中的首次交战。美军击退了对村镇及其重要造船厂的进攻。该造船厂为这场战争建造了12艘军舰。

en.s: The Battle of Ekau (also the Battle of Iecava) took place during the initial phase of the French invasion of Russia. Napoleon's troops from the X Corps of Marshal MacDonald, who had the advantage, defeated the troops of Alexander I defending under the command of General Friedrich von Löwis of Menar.

zh.s: 埃考战役又称耶察瓦战役，发生在法国入侵俄罗斯初期。拿破仑的第十军团由麦克唐纳元帅指挥，在兵力占优的情况下击败了亚历山大一世的守军；俄军由弗里德里希·冯·勒维斯·德·梅纳尔将军指挥。

en.s: The Battle of Rock Island Rapids, also called the Battle of Campbell Island, was an American defeat during the War of 1812 at the hands of the British allied Sauk, Meskwaki, and Kickapoo. In July 1814, a military expedition was mounted to supply the U.S. garrison at Prairie du Chien after calls for help. The U.S. expedition was ambushed on July 19.

zh.s: 罗克艾兰急流战役又称坎贝尔岛战役，是1812年战争期间美国军队遭到英国及其盟友索克人、梅斯夸基人和基卡普人击败的一场战斗。1814年7月，应援助请求，美军组织了一支军事远征队，为草原迪谢恩驻军运送补给。该远征队于7月19日遭到伏击。

en.s: Partial legislative elections were held in France in 1818, during the Bourbon Restoration. The election resulted in little change in the party-makeup parliament. However, deputies from the Napoleonic era saw a continued resurgence in the Parliament, while those from the Kingdom of France saw a continued decline.

en.t: Coronation of George IV of the United Kingdom
en.s: George IV (George Augustus Frederick; 12 August 1762 – 26 June 1830) was King of the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland and King of Hanover from 29 January 1820 until his death in 1830. At the time of his accession to the throne, he was acting as prince regent for his father, King George III, having done so since 5 February 1811 during his father's final mental illness.

zh.t: 英国国王乔治四世加冕
zh.s: 乔治四世（乔治·奥古斯都·弗雷德里克；1762年8月12日—1830年6月26日）于1820年1月29日起担任大不列颠及爱尔兰联合王国国王和汉诺威国王，直至1830年去世。即位时，他仍代替父亲乔治三世担任摄政王；自1811年2月5日起，乔治三世便因精神疾病末期而无法执政。

en.t: The British Medical Association is founded as the Provincial Medical and Surgical Association by Sir Charles Hastings at a meeting in the Board Room of the Worcester Infirmary
en.s: The British Medical Association (BMA) is a registered trade union and professional body for doctors in the United Kingdom. It does not regulate or certify doctors, a responsibility which lies with the General Medical Council. The BMA has a range of representative and scientific committees and is recognised by National Health Service (NHS) employers alongside the Hospital Consultants and Specialists Association as one of two national contract negotiators for doctors.

zh.t: 英国医学会成立，前身为省级医学与外科学会，由查尔斯·黑斯廷斯爵士在伍斯特医务室会议室主持成立会议
zh.s: 英国医学会（BMA）是英国注册工会和医生专业团体。该协会不负责监管或认证医生，这项职责由英国医学总会承担。英国医学会下设多个代表性和科学委员会；英国国家医疗服务体系（NHS）的雇主承认它与医院顾问和专科医师协会是医生全国合同谈判的两家机构之一。

en.t: Great New York City Fire of 1845
en.s: The Great New York City Fire of 1845 broke out on July 19, 1845, in Lower Manhattan, New York City. The fire started in a whale oil and candle manufacturing establishment and quickly spread to other wooden structures. It reached a warehouse at 38 Broad Street where combustible saltpeter was stored and caused a massive explosion that spread the fire even farther.

zh.s: 1845年7月19日，纽约市曼哈顿下城发生大火。火灾始于一家鲸油和蜡烛制造厂，迅速蔓延至其他木制建筑。大火烧到位于布罗德街38号、存放易燃硝石的仓库，并引发巨大爆炸，使火势进一步扩大。

en.s: The Seneca Falls Convention was the first women's rights convention. Its organizers advertised it as "a convention to discuss the social, civil, and religious condition and rights of woman". Held in the Wesleyan Chapel of the town of Seneca Falls, New York, it spanned two days over July 19–20, 1848. Attracting widespread attention, it was soon followed by other women's rights conventions, including the Rochester Women's Rights Convention in Rochester, New York, two weeks later.

zh.s: 塞内卡福尔斯会议是首场妇女权利大会，组织者将会议宣传为讨论女性社会、公民和宗教状况及权利的大会。会议于1848年7月19日至20日在纽约州塞内卡福尔斯镇的卫斯理礼拜堂举行，为期两天。会议引起广泛关注，两周后，纽约州罗切斯特等地也相继举行妇女权利大会。

en.s: The Battle of Buffington Island, also known as the St. Georges Creek Skirmish, was an American Civil War engagement in Meigs County, Ohio, and Jackson County, West Virginia, on July 19, 1863, during Morgan's Raid. The largest battle in Ohio during the war, Buffington Island contributed to the capture of the famed Confederate cavalry raider, Brig. Gen. John Hunt Morgan, who was seeking to escape Union army pursuers across the Ohio River at a ford opposite Buffington Island. Delayed overnight, Morgan was almost surrounded by Union cavalry the next day, and the resulting battle ended in a Confederate rout, with over half of the 1,700-man Confederate force being captured.

zh.s: 巴芬顿岛战役又称圣乔治溪小冲突，是美国南北战争期间摩根突袭行动中的一场战斗，于1863年7月19日在俄亥俄州梅格斯县和西弗吉尼亚州杰克逊县爆发。这是战争期间俄亥俄州规模最大的战斗。摩根准将约翰·亨特·摩根率领南方邦联骑兵突袭部队，试图在巴芬顿岛对岸的浅滩渡过俄亥俄河，摆脱联邦军追兵。摩根的部队因此耽搁了一夜，第二天几乎被联邦骑兵包围，战斗以南方邦联军大败告终。其1,700名士兵中有一半以上被俘。

en.s: Morgan's Raid (also the Calico Raid or Great Raid of 1863) was a diversionary incursion by Confederate cavalry into the Union states of Indiana, Ohio, and West Virginia during the American Civil War. The raid took place from June 11 to July 26, 1863. It is named for the commander of the Confederate troops, Brigadier General John Hunt Morgan. Although it caused temporary alarm in the North, the raid failed.
en.n: American Civil War: Morgan's Raid: At Buffington Island in Ohio, Confederate General John Hunt Morgan's raid into the north is mostly thwarted when a large group of his men are captured while trying to escape across the Ohio River.

zh.s: 摩根突袭又称“印花布突袭”或“1863年大突袭”，是美国内战期间邦联骑兵对联邦州印第安纳、俄亥俄和西弗吉尼亚发动的一次牵制性入侵。突袭从1863年6月11日持续至7月26日，以邦联军指挥官约翰·亨特·摩根准将命名。突袭虽一度引发北方恐慌，但最终失败。
zh.n: 美国内战：摩根突袭中，约翰·亨特·摩根将军率部北上，试图从俄亥俄州巴芬顿岛渡过俄亥俄河撤退时，大批部下被俘，突袭行动因此基本受挫。

en.s: The Taiping Rebellion, also known as the Taiping Civil War, Revolution, or Movement, was a civil war in late imperial China between the Qing dynasty and the rebel Taiping Heavenly Kingdom. The conflict lasted 14 years, from its outbreak in 1850 until the fall of Taiping-controlled Nanjing—which had been renamed to Tianjing ("heavenly capital")—in 1864. The last rebel forces were defeated in August 1871.
en.n: Taiping Rebellion: Third Battle of Nanking: The Qing dynasty finally defeats the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom.

zh.s: 太平天国运动又称太平天国战争、革命或运动，是晚期帝制中国清朝与叛军太平天国之间的一场内战。冲突持续14年，从1850年爆发到1864年太平天国控制的南京陷落为止；该城当时更名为“天京”。最后一批叛军于1871年8月被击败。
zh.n: 太平天国运动：第三次南京战役中，清朝最终击败太平天国。

en.s: The Third Battle of Nanjing in 1864 was the last major engagement of the Taiping Rebellion in the Qing Empire. With the fall of Nanjing, the capital of the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom, the rebellion came to an end. The Hunan Army, an unpaid and barely fed militia commissioned by the Qing Empire, lost all their discipline and committed mass-scale random murder, wartime rape, looting and arson against the civilians of Nanjing, seen as "rebels". 200,000–300,000 "rebels" were reported dead by Zeng Guofan, the commander-in-chief of the Hunan Army.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1864年，南京第三次战役是清帝国太平天国运动期间最后一场大规模战斗。随着太平天国首都南京陷落，叛乱宣告结束。清帝国征召的湖南军是一支未获军饷、粮食也难以保障的民团；军队失去纪律后，在南京对被视为“叛军”的平民实施大规模无差别杀戮、战时强奸、掠夺和纵火。湖南军总司令曾国藩报告称有20万至30万名“叛军”死亡。

en.s: The Franco-Prussian War or Franco-German War (German: Deutsch-Französischer Krieg, French: Guerre franco-allemande), often referred to in France as the War of 1870 (19 July 1870 – 10 May 1871), was a conflict between the Second French Empire of Napoleon III and the German states of the North German Confederation led by the Kingdom of Prussia. The conflict was caused by Prussian ambitions to extend German unification and French fears of the shift in the European balance of power that would result if the Prussians succeeded.

zh.s: 普法战争又称法德战争（德语：Deutsch-Französischer Krieg；法语：Guerre franco-allemande），在法国常被称为1870年战争，发生于1870年7月19日至1871年5月10日。交战一方是拿破仑三世统治下的法兰西第二帝国，另一方是由普鲁士王国领导的北德意志邦联诸邦。普鲁士试图推动德国统一，法国则担心这会改变欧洲的力量平衡，冲突由此引发。

en.s: The Revolt of the Muckers was a conflict between two groups in a German community in Southern Brazil, in 1873 and 1874. It took place in the region of Sapiranga, Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil. Jacobina Mentz Maurer, believed by some to be a prophet, led a conflict that was eventually quelled by the Brazilian military, and its leaders either killed or arrested and imprisoned.

en.s: The Battle of Eski Zagra was a military engagement that took place in the city of Stara Zagora on 19 July 1877 during the Russo-Turkish War. As a result of a well-planned counteroffensive, the Ottoman troops were able to unexpectedly strike at the Russians and force them to retreat to the Balkan Mountains.

zh.s: 埃斯基扎格拉战役于1877年7月19日在俄土战争期间爆发，战场位于今保加利亚旧扎戈拉市。奥斯曼军队有计划地发动反攻，出其不意地打击俄军，迫使其撤退到巴尔干山脉。

en.t: First line of the Paris Métro opens
en.s: The Paris Metro, short for Métropolitain, is a rapid transit system serving the Paris metropolitan area in Île-de-France, the region of France's capital. A symbol of the city, it is known for its density within the capital's territorial limits, as well as its uniform architecture and historical entrances influenced by Art Nouveau.

zh.t: 巴黎地铁首条线路开通
zh.s: 巴黎地铁是巴黎大都会区的快速交通系统；其全称Métropolitain意为“大都会铁路”，服务范围覆盖法国首都所在的法兰西岛大区。它是这座城市的象征，以市区内密集的线路网络、统一的建筑风格和受新艺术运动影响的历史入口而闻名。

en.s: The 1903 Tour de France was the first cycling race set up and sponsored by the newspaper L'Auto, ancestor of the current daily, L'Équipe. It ran from 1 to 19 July in six stages over 2,428 km (1,509 mi), and was won by Maurice Garin. The race was invented to boost the circulation of L'Auto, after its circulation started to plummet from competition with the long-standing Le Vélo.

zh.s: 1903年环法自行车赛是报纸《L’Auto》创办并赞助的首届自行车比赛；《L’Auto》是现今日报《队报》的前身。赛事于7月1日至19日分6个赛段举行，全程2,428公里（1,509英里），莫里斯·加兰夺冠。赛事旨在提升《L’Auto》的发行量；当时该报正受到老牌报纸《自行车报》的竞争，发行量开始大幅下滑。

en.s: The Battle of Podgora was a battle between Italian and Austro-Hungarian forces during World War I on the Isonzo front. Podgora, also known as Monte Calvario in Italian and Kalvarija in Slovenian, was a key defensive position for the Austro-Hungarian forces during the early battles of the Isonzo, protecting the strategic city of Gorizia. Heavily fortified with trenches, barbed wire, and machine-gun posts, it was supported by artillery on the peaks.

zh.s: 第一次世界大战期间，意大利军队与奥匈帝国军队在伊松佐前线的波德戈拉交战。波德戈拉也称意大利语的卡尔瓦里奥山、斯洛文尼亚语的卡尔瓦里亚山，是奥匈军队在伊松佐早期战役中的重要防御阵地，守护着战略要地戈里齐亚。当地工事坚固，修有战壕、铁丝网和机枪阵地，山顶还配有炮兵。

en.s: The Attack at Fromelles (French pronunciation: [fʁɔmɛl] (Battle of Fromelles, Battle of Fleurbaix or Schlacht von Fromelles) was a military operation on the Western Front during the First World War on 19–20 July 1916. The attack was carried out by British and Australian troops and was subsidiary to the Battle of the Somme.

zh.s: 弗罗梅勒攻势又称弗勒尔贝战役或弗罗梅勒战役，是第一次世界大战西线于1916年7月19日至20日展开的一次军事行动。英军和澳大利亚军队发动了这次进攻，作为索姆河战役的辅助行动。

en.s: The Kerensky offensive (Russian: Наступление Керенского), also called the summer offensive, the June offensive (Russian: Июньское наступление) in Russia, or the July offensive in Western historiography, took place from 1 July [O.S. 18 June] to 19 July [O.S. 6 July] 1917 and was the last Russian offensive of World War I, named after the minister of war, Alexander Kerensky.

zh.s: 克伦斯基攻势（俄语：Наступление Керенского）又称夏季攻势；在俄罗斯也称六月攻势（俄语：Июньское наступление），西方史学界则称七月攻势。该行动于1917年7月1日（儒略历6月18日）至7月19日（儒略历7月6日）进行，是第一次世界大战期间俄军最后一次攻势，名称源自时任战争部长亚历山大·克伦斯基。

en.s: The Tondern raid, officially designated Operation F.7, was a British bombing raid mounted by the Royal Navy and Royal Air Force against the Imperial German Navy's airship base at Tønder, Denmark, then a part of Germany. It was the first attack in history made by aircraft flying from a carrier flight deck. On 19 July 1918 seven Sopwith Camels took off from the converted battlecruiser Furious. For the loss of one man, the British destroyed two German zeppelins, L 54 and L 60, and a captive balloon.

zh.s: 通德恩突袭正式代号为F.7行动，是英国皇家海军和皇家空军针对德国帝国海军位于通德恩的飞艇基地发动的一次空袭。当时通德恩属于德国，现今在丹麦境内。这是历史上首次从航空母舰飞行甲板起飞飞机发动的攻击。1918年7月19日，7架索普威思骆驼式飞机从改装后的战列巡洋舰“暴怒”号起飞。英军损失1人，摧毁了德国飞艇L 54和L 60以及一只系留气球。

en.t: Spanish Civil War: The CNT and UGT call a general strike in Spain – mobilizing workers' militias against the Nationalist forces. People's Olympiad of Barcelona cancelled
en.s: The Spanish Civil War (Spanish: guerra civil española) was fought in Spain from 1936 to 1939 between the Republicans and the Nationalist rebels. Republicans loyal to the left-leaning Popular Front government of the Second Spanish Republic included socialists, anarchists, communists, and separatists, supported by the Soviet Union. The opposing Nationalists were an alliance of Falangists, monarchists, conservatives, traditionalists, syndicalists and fascists, supported by Nazi Germany and Fascist Italy.

zh.s: 西班牙内战（西班牙语：guerra civil española）于1936年至1939年在西班牙爆发，交战双方是共和派和国民军叛军。支持左翼人民阵线政府的共和派包括社会主义者、无政府主义者、共产党人和分离主义者，并得到苏联支持。国民军则由长枪党、君主主义者、保守派、传统主义者、工团主义者和法西斯主义者组成联盟，得到纳粹德国和法西斯意大利支持。

en.s: The Battle of Cape Spada (Battaglia di Capo Spada) was a naval battle between the Royal Navy and the Regia Marina during the Battle of the Mediterranean in the second World War. It took place during the morning of 19 July 1940 off Cape Spada, the north-western extremity of Crete. The Italian 2ª Divisione Incrociatori (2nd Cruiser Division) comprised the fast light cruisers Giovanni delle Bande Nere and Bartolomeo Colleoni.

en.t: Defense of Huta Stepańska and Wyrka
en.s: The Defense of Huta Stepańska and Wyrka (Polish: Obrona Huty Stepańskiej i Wyrki, Ukrainian: Оборона Гути Степанської і Вирки; 16–19 July 1943) was fought between the 1st Operational Group “Zahrava” in the Northern Operational Group and 6th Operational Group “Syan” in the Western Operational Group of the Ukrainian Insurgent Army and Kusch Units of the Ukrainian Self–Defense under the command of Ivan Lytvynchuk, Dmytro Voytseshko, Vasyl Pavlonyuk, Dmytro Korinets, Dmytro Kalynyuk, and Makar Melnyk against the Polish Self–Defense, Home Army and Soviet partisans under the command of Jan Szabelski, Władysław Kochański and Józef Sobiesiak in the outskirts of the villages of Huta Stepańska and Wyrka in the Kostopol County of the Wołyń Voivodeship.

zh.t: 胡塔·斯泰潘斯卡和维尔卡防御战

en.t: Korean politician Lyuh Woon-hyung is assassinated
en.s: Lyuh Woon-hyung (Korean: 여운형; Hanja: 呂運亨; 25 May 1886 – 19 July 1947), also known by his art name Mongyang (몽양; 夢陽), was a Korean independence activist and reunification activist. zh.s: 吕运亨（韩语：여운형；汉字：呂運亨；1886年5月25日—1947年7月19日），号梦阳（몽양；夢陽），是韩国独立运动和统一运动人士。他是大韩民国临时政府（KPG）的重要人物，曾在日本殖民统治时期参与起草“二八独立宣言”。

He was instrumental in Myanmar's struggle for independence from British rule, but he was assassinated just six months before his goal was realized.

zh.s: 昂山（缅甸语：အောင်ဆန်း；MLCTS转写：aung hcan:；读音：[àʊɰ̃ sʰáɰ̃]；1915年2月13日—1947年7月19日）是缅甸政治家、独立运动活动家和革命者。他在缅甸脱离英国统治、争取独立的斗争中发挥了关键作用，但在目标即将实现前六个月遇刺身亡。

en.s: The Ordeal of Gilbert Pinfold is a novel by the British writer Evelyn Waugh, first published in July 1957. en.s: The 1987 Portuguese legislative election took place on 19 July. The election renewed all 250 members of the Assembly of the Republic. en.s: United Airlines Flight 232 was a regularly scheduled United Airlines flight from Stapleton International Airport in Denver to O'Hare International Airport in Chicago, continuing to Philadelphia International Airport in Philadelphia, United States. en.s: The 1997 Liberian general election was held on 19 July 1997 as part of the 1996 peace agreement ending the First Liberian Civil War. The presidency, as well as all seats in the House of Representatives and the Senate were up for election. Voter turnout was around 89%. Former rebel leader Charles Taylor and his National Patriotic Party (NPP) won the election by a substantial margin; Taylor won 75.3% of the vote in the presidential election, whilst the NPP won the same number of votes in the parliamentary election. Taylor was inaugurated as president on 2 August 1997.

zh.s: 利比里亚于1997年7月19日举行大选，这是结束第一次利比里亚内战的1996年和平协议的一部分。总统职位以及众议院和参议院的全部席位都进行选举，投票率约为89%。前反叛组织领导人查尔斯·泰勒和其领导的全国爱国党以明显优势胜出：泰勒在总统选举中获得75.3%的选票，该党在国会选举中也获得相同的得票率。泰勒于1997年8月2日就任总统。

en.s: The Sedgefield by-election, 2007 was a by-election held on 19 July 2007 for the British House of Commons constituency of Sedgefield in County Durham. The Ealing Southall by-election was also held on 19 July. The by-election was triggered when Tony Blair, the Labour Party Member of Parliament (MP) for Sedgefield and former Prime Minister, "resigned" to become envoy for the international diplomatic Quartet on the Middle East. To resign as an MP, Blair accepted the office of Steward and Bailiff of the Three Hundreds of Chiltern, thereby deliberately disqualifying himself from Parliament and causing the by-election.

en.s: The Ealing Southall by-election, 2007 was a by-election for the British House of Commons constituency of Ealing Southall, in west London. It was held on 19 July 2007. The election was triggered when Piara Khabra, the Labour Party Member of Parliament for Ealing Southall, died on 19 June 2007. Khabra had held the constituency since the 1992 election, while the Labour party has held the seat since its creation in the 1983 election, and the predecessor seat of Southall since it was created before the 1945 election. The government moved the writ for the by-election in Parliament on 28 June 2007, the day after the funeral of Piara Khabra.

zh.s: 英国下议院西伦敦伊灵南索尔选区于2007年7月19日举行补选。补选因该区工党议员皮亚拉·卡布拉于2007年6月19日去世而触发。卡布拉自1992年大选起担任该选区议员；自1983年创设该选区以来，工党一直持有该席位；其前身南索尔选区在1945年大选前创设后，工党也一直持有该席位。政府于2007年6月28日在议会提出补选令状；当天是卡布拉的葬礼次日。

en.s: An indirect presidential election was held in Suriname on 19 July 2010 following the legislative election. If the National Assembly of Suriname twice fails to elect a new president with a two-thirds majority, the election will go to the People's Assembly of Suriname, composed of members of parliament, district and provincial councils, where a simple majority suffices. A first vote was expected on 8 July 2010, but only procedural issues were discussed at the meeting; the election was set for 19 July 2010 on the following day.

zh.s: 苏里南于2010年7月19日举行间接总统选举，此前该国举行了议会选举。如果苏里南国民议会两次都未能以三分之二多数选出新总统，选举将交由苏里南人民大会举行。人民大会由议员、地区议会和省议会成员组成，以简单多数决定结果。首轮投票原定于2010年7月8日举行，但当天会议只讨论了程序问题；次日宣布选举改在7月19日举行。

en.s: The 14th indirect presidential election, in order to elect the 13th president, was held in India on 19 July 2012. The two leading candidates for the presidency were former Finance Minister Pranab Mukherjee from West Bengal and former Speaker of the Lok Sabha P. A. Sangma from Meghalaya. en.s: The Battle of Aleppo (Arabic: مَعْرَكَةُ حَلَبَ, romanized: Maʿrakat Ḥalab) was a major military confrontation in Aleppo, the largest city in Syria by urban area, between the Syrian opposition militias (such as the Free Syrian Army (FSA), the Levant Front and Al-Nusra Front) against the Ba'athist Syrian government and army, supported by Russia, Iran, Hezbollah and other Shia militant groups backed by the IRGC, and other pro-government Syrian and Palestinian militias, and against the Kurdish-majority People's Protection Units (YPG). The battle began on 19 July 2012 and was part of the Syrian civil war.

en.s: Battleground (2015) was a professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event produced by WWE. It took place on July 19, 2015, at the Scottrade Center in St. Louis, Missouri. It was the third event under the Battleground chronology. Battleground was available for free to new subscribers on WWE's monthly subscription service, the WWE Network in over 140 countries. Seven matches were contested at the event, including one match on the pre-show. In the main event between WWE World Heavyweight Champion Seth Rollins and Brock Lesnar ended in a disqualification, when The Undertaker made his unexpected return (and his first appearance on pay-per-view in WWE since WrestleMania 31) and attacked Lesnar.

en.t: Basic Law: Israel as the Nation-State of the Jewish People

en.t: The Horror Show at Extreme Rules
en.s: The Horror Show at Extreme Rules was a 2020 professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) and livestreaming event produced by WWE, held for wrestlers from the promotion's main roster brands, Raw and SmackDown. It was the 12th annual Extreme Rules event and was broadcast on July 19, 2020. While the majority of the event aired live from the WWE Performance Center in Orlando, Florida, the main event was pre-recorded at an undisclosed location about two hours outside of Orlando on July 16–17.

en.s: The 2021 Iraq FA Cup final was the 28th final of the Iraq FA Cup as a club competition. The match was contested between Al-Zawraa and Al-Quwa Al-Jawiya, at Al-Shaab Stadium in Baghdad. en.s: The 2023 Major League Soccer All-Star Game was the 27th annual Major League Soccer All-Star Game, an exhibition soccer match in the United States. The game, featuring an all-star team from Major League Soccer (MLS) and Premier League club Arsenal, was played on July 19, 2023, at Audi Field in Washington, D.C. The all-star game also included a skills challenge, concerts, and other events in the days before the match.

en.s: The final match of the 2026 FIFA World Cup—the 23rd edition of the FIFA competition for men's national soccer teams—was played at MetLife Stadium in East Rutherford, New Jersey, part of the New York metropolitan area, on July 19, 2026. It was contested by Spain and defending champion Argentina. The tournament was contested by hosts Canada, Mexico, and the United States, along with 45 other teams who emerged from the qualification phase, which was organized by the six FIFA confederations.

zh.s: 2026年国际足联世界杯决赛是第23届国际足联男子国家队世界杯的最后一场比赛，于2026年7月19日在新泽西州东卢瑟福的MetLife体育场举行，该地属于纽约都会区。参赛双方是西班牙队和卫冕冠军阿根廷队。加拿大、墨西哥和美国作为东道主，与通过六个国际足联联合会组织的预选赛晋级的另外45支球队共同参加本届赛事。
